nodes.action: Read the documented input, validation, API, and output contracts; identify existing helpers and side effects.
nodes.name: Inspect project contract
preconditions: Target project and input batch are available
nodes.validator: Required rules and interfaces are explicitly identified before editing.

nodes.action: Parse the batch and derive normalized field values, preserving each original record and its zero-based index.
nodes.name: Normalize each record
nodes.validator: Every input record has exactly one preserved index and normalization result.

nodes.action: Evaluate all applicable field and cross-field rules for each record, collecting every failure into the required structured error shape without short-circuiting.
nodes.name: Collect validation failures
nodes.validator: Rejected records contain original data, index, and all discovered errors; accepted records have no validation failures.

nodes.action: Send only accepted records through the existing outbound operation, preserving input order and recording the outbound trace or results.
nodes.name: Dispatch accepted records
nodes.validator: No rejected record appears in the outbound trace, and accepted records are processed in order.

nodes.action: Construct the structured invalid-record report using the documented per-record and per-error fields.
nodes.name: Build rejection report
preconditions: Rejected records with complete errors are available
nodes.validator: Each failure has its original index and errors use one consistent schema with useful values and expectations.

nodes.action: Return the documented aggregate result and verify totals, ordering, and the invariant that invalid records were never dispatched.
nodes.name: Assemble and verify batch result
nodes.validator: The result matches the public contract; success plus failure counts equal input count and trace contents match accepted records.
